run_sapiens_pose_training: run the sapiens 0.6b pose estimation model training on COCO dataset for 210 epochs
configure_sapiens_backbone: configure the sapiens 0.6b VisionTransformer backbone with 1280 embed dim and 32 layers
set_optimizer_config: set the AdamW optimizer with layer decay rate 0.85 and gradient clipping for pose training
configure_train_pipeline: configure the training data pipeline with random flip, bbox transform, and albumentation augmentations
set_evaluation_config: set the COCO validation evaluator with CocoMetric and person detection bbox file
